text: Ekoï is a French cycling-equipment company founded in 2001 by Jean-Christophe Rattel together with a friend; it moved to Fréjus in 2008 and Rattel remains its managing director.
short: Ekoï is a French private company founded in 2001 by Jean-Christophe Rattel, based in Fréjus.

source.name: TOUR Magazin, 'Ekoi interview: Many brands will disappear' (interview with CEO Jean-Christophe Rattel)
source.quote: The French brand Ekoi was founded in Roubaix in 2001 and is now headquartered in Fréjus.
